program count_substring
    implicit none
    character(len=100) :: string, substring
    integer :: count, i, len_str, len_sub
    
    ! Read input from stdin
    read(*, '(A)') string
    read(*, '(A)') substring
    
    ! Get lengths
    len_str = len_trim(string)
    len_sub = len_trim(substring)
    
    ! Count overlapping occurrences
    count = 0
    if (len_sub > 0 .and. len_sub <= len_str) then
        do i = 1, len_str - len_sub + 1
            if (string(i:i+len_sub-1) == substring) then
                count = count + 1
            end if
        end do
    end if
    
    ! Output result to stdout
    write(*, '(I0)') count
end program count_substring

program find_closest
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: max_len = 100
    integer :: n, i, j, min_idx, min_idx2
    real :: numbers(max_len), diff, min_diff
    
    ! Read array length
    read(*, *) n
    
    ! Read array elements
    read(*, *) numbers(1:n)
    
    ! Initialize with first pair
    min_diff = abs(numbers(2) - numbers(1))
    min_idx = 1
    min_idx2 = 2
    
    ! Find the closest pair
    do i = 1, n-1
        do j = i+1, n
            diff = abs(numbers(j) - numbers(i))
            if (diff < min_diff) then
                min_diff = diff
                min_idx = i
                min_idx2 = j
            end if
        end do
    end do
    
    ! Output the closest pair in order (smaller, larger)
    if (numbers(min_idx) < numbers(min_idx2)) then
        print *, numbers(min_idx), numbers(min_idx2)
    else
        print *, numbers(min_idx2), numbers(min_idx)
    end if
    
end program find_closest

program prime_factors
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer :: i
    integer, dimension(100) :: factors
    integer :: count
    integer :: temp

    ! Read input
    read(*,*) n

    ! Handle edge cases
    if (n <= 1) then
        write(*,*)
        stop
    end if

    ! Initialize count
    count = 0

    ! Find prime factors
    temp = n
    i = 2
    do while (i * i <= temp)
        do while (mod(temp, i) == 0)
            count = count + 1
            factors(count) = i
            temp = temp / i
        end do
        i = i + 1
    end do

    ! If temp > 1, then it's a prime factor
    if (temp > 1) then
        count = count + 1
        factors(count) = temp
    end if

    ! Output the factors
    do i = 1, count
        if (i > 1) write(*,*) ' '
        write(*,*) factors(i)
    end do

end program prime_factors

program modp
  implicit none
  integer :: n, p, result, base
  
  ! Read input
  read *, n
  read *, p
  
  ! Compute 2^n mod p using modular exponentiation
  result = 1
  base = 2
  do while (n > 0)
    if (mod(n, 2) == 1) then
      result = mod(result * base, p)
    end if
    base = mod(base * base, p)
    n = n / 2
  end do
  
  ! Output result
  write (*, *) result
end program modp

program decode_shift
    implicit none
    character(len=100) :: input_str
    character(len=100) :: result
    integer :: i
    integer :: char_code
    integer :: shifted_code
    
    read *, input_str
    
    result = input_str
    
    do i = 1, len_trim(input_str)
        char_code = iachar(input_str(i:i))
        
        if (char_code >= ichar('a') .and. char_code <= ichar('z')) then
            shifted_code = char_code - 5
            if (shifted_code < ichar('a')) then
                shifted_code = shifted_code + 26
            end if
            result(i:i) = achar(shifted_code)
        else if (char_code >= ichar('A') .and. char_code <= ichar('Z')) then
            shifted_code = char_code - 5
            if (shifted_code < ichar('A')) then
                shifted_code = shifted_code + 26
            end if
            result(i:i) = achar(shifted_code)
        end if
    end do
    
    print *, result

program triangle_area
    implicit none
    real :: a, b, c, area, s
    real :: result

    ! Read input
    read *, a
    read *, b
    read *, c

    ! Check if triangle is valid using triangle inequality theorem
    if (a + b > c .and. a + c > b .and. b + c > a) then
        ! Calculate semi-perimeter
        s = (a + b + c) / 2.0
        ! Calculate area using Heron's formula
        area = sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))
        ! Output area rounded to 2 decimal places
        write (*, '(F6.2)') area
    else
        ! Output -1 for invalid triangle
        write (*, '(I6)') -1
    end if

end program triangle_area

program is_simple_power
    implicit none
    integer :: x, n
    integer :: k
    integer :: temp
    
    ! Read input
    read *, x
    read *, n
    
    ! Check if x is a simple power of n
    if (n == 0) then
        if (x == 0) then
            print *, .true.
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    else if (n == 1) then
        if (x == 1) then
            print *, .true.
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    else if (x == 1) then
        print *, .true.
    else if (x < 0) then
        if (n < 0) then
            ! Check if x is a power of n with even exponent
            temp = abs(x)
            k = 0
            do while (n**k < temp)
                k = k + 1
                if (n**k > temp) exit
            end do
            if (n**k == temp) then
                if (mod(k, 2) == 0) then
                    print *, .true.
                else
                    print *, .false.
                end if
            else
                print *, .false.
            end if
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    else
        ! x > 0 and n > 0
        k = 0
        do while (n**k < x)
            k = k + 1
            if (n**k > x) exit
        end do
        if (n**k == x) then
            print *, .true.
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    end if

    implicit none
    integer :: a
    integer :: root
    logical :: result
    
    ! Read input
    read *, a

        root = int(a**(1.0/3.0))
        if (root**3 == a) then
            result = .true.
        else
            result = .false.

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

end program collatz_odds

    integer :: n_input, i

    do i = 2, n_input

    end do

    end if

    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: max_len = 1000
    integer :: n, i, j, temp
    integer, allocatable :: x(:), result(:)
    integer :: len_result
    integer :: digit

    read(*, *) x

            i = i + 1
            result(i) = x(j)

        do j = i + 1, len_result
            if (result(i) > result(j)) then
                temp = result(i)
                result(i) = result(j)
                result(j) = temp

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program find_closest
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: max_len = 100
    integer :: n, i, j, min_idx, min_idx2
    real :: numbers(max_len), diff, min_diff
    
    ! Read array length
    read(*, *) n
    
    ! Read array elements
    read(*, *) numbers(1:n)
    
    ! Initialize with first pair
    min_diff = abs(numbers(2) - numbers(1))
    min_idx = 1
    min_idx2 = 2
    
    ! Find the closest pair
    do i = 1, n-1
        do j = i+1, n
            diff = abs(numbers(j) - numbers(i))
            if (diff < min_diff) then
                min_diff = diff
                min_idx = i
                min_idx2 = j
            end if
        end do
    end do
    
    ! Output the closest pair in order (smaller, larger)
    if (numbers(min_idx) < numbers(min_idx2)) then
        print *, numbers(min_idx), numbers(min_idx2)
    else
        print *, numbers(min_idx2), numbers(min_idx)
    end if
    
end program find_closest

program rescale_to_unit
    implicit none
    integer :: n_input, i
    real, allocatable :: numbers(:), rescaled(:)
    real :: min_val, max_val
    
    ! Read input
    read(*,*) n_input
    allocate(numbers(n_input))
    read(*,*) numbers
    
    ! Find min and max
    min_val = numbers(1)
    max_val = numbers(1)
    do i = 2, n_input
        if (numbers(i) < min_val) min_val = numbers(i)
        if (numbers(i) > max_val) max_val = numbers(i)
    end do
    
    ! Apply linear transform
    if (max_val == min_val) then
        rescaled = 0.0
    else
        rescaled = (numbers - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
    end if
    
    ! Output result
    do i = 1, n_input
        write(*, '(F8.3)') rescaled(i)
    end do
    
    deallocate(numbers)
end program rescale_to_unit

program prime_factors
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer :: i
    integer, dimension(100) :: factors
    integer :: count
    integer :: temp

    ! Read input
    read(*,*) n

    ! Handle edge cases
    if (n <= 1) then
        write(*,*)
        stop
    end if

    ! Initialize count
    count = 0

    ! Find prime factors
    temp = n
    i = 2
    do while (i * i <= temp)
        do while (mod(temp, i) == 0)
            count = count + 1
            factors(count) = i
            temp = temp / i
        end do
        i = i + 1
    end do

    ! If temp > 1, then it's a prime factor
    if (temp > 1) then
        count = count + 1
        factors(count) = temp
    end if

    ! Output the factors
    do i = 1, count
        if (i > 1) write(*,*) ' '
        write(*,*) factors(i)
    end do

end program prime_factors

  implicit none
  integer :: n, p, result, base
  
  ! Read input
  read *, n
  read *, p
  
  ! Compute 2^n mod p using modular exponentiation
  result = 1
  base = 2
  do while (n > 0)
    if (mod(n, 2) == 1) then
      result = mod(result * base, p)

  end do

    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: max_len = 1000
    integer :: n, i, j, temp
    integer, allocatable :: x(:), result(:)
    integer :: len_result
    integer :: digit
    
    ! Read array length
    read(*, *) n
    
    ! Read array elements
    allocate(x(n))
    read(*, *) x
    
    ! Filter elements without even digits
    len_result = 0
    do i = 1, n
        if (has_only_odd_digits(x(i))) then
            len_result = len_result + 1
        end if
    end do
    
    ! Allocate result array
    allocate(result(len_result))
    
    ! Copy filtered elements
    i = 0
    do j = 1, n
        if (has_only_odd_digits(x(j))) then
            i = i + 1
            result(i) = x(j)
        end if
    end do
    
    ! Sort result array using bubble sort
    do i = 1, len_result - 1
        do j = i + 1, len_result
            if (result(i) > result(j)) then
                temp = result(i)
                result(i) = result(j)
                result(j) = temp
            end if
        end do
    end do
    
    ! Output result
    do i = 1, len_result
        write(*, '(I0)') result(i)
    end do

        integer, intent(in) :: num
        logical :: has_odd
        integer :: temp, digit
        
        has_odd = .true.
        temp = num
        
        do while (temp > 0)
            digit = mod(temp, 10)
            if (mod(digit, 2) == 0) then

                exit

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if

    end do

    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else

        end if

        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then

        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if

    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    end if

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count

    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

end program collatz_odds

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    real, allocatable :: numbers(:), rescaled(:)
    real :: min_val, max_val
    
    ! Read input
    read(*,*) n_input
    allocate(numbers(n_input))
    read(*,*) numbers
    
    ! Find min and max
    min_val = numbers(1)
    max_val = numbers(1)
    do i = 2, n_input

    end if
    
    ! Output result

        write(*, '(F8.3)') rescaled(i)
    end do
    
    deallocate(numbers)

    implicit none
    integer :: x, n
    integer :: k
    integer :: temp
    
    ! Read input
    read *, x
    read *, n
    
    ! Check if x is a simple power of n
    if (n == 0) then
        if (x == 0) then
            print *, .true.
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    else if (n == 1) then
        if (x == 1) then
            print *, .true.
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    else if (x == 1) then
        print *, .true.
    else if (x < 0) then
        if (n < 0) then
            ! Check if x is a power of n with even exponent
            temp = abs(x)
            k = 0
            do while (n**k < temp)
                k = k + 1
                if (n**k > temp) exit
            end do
            if (n**k == temp) then
                if (mod(k, 2) == 0) then
                    print *, .true.
                else
                    print *, .false.
                end if
            else
                print *, .false.
            end if
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    else
        ! x > 0 and n > 0
        k = 0
        do while (n**k < x)
            k = k + 1
            if (n**k > x) exit
        end do
        if (n**k == x) then
            print *, .true.
        else
            print *, .false.
        end if
    end if

    integer, parameter :: max_len = 1000
    integer :: n, i, j, temp
    integer, allocatable :: x(:), result(:)
    integer :: len_result
    integer :: digit

    read(*, *) x

    len_result = 0

            len_result = len_result + 1

    do j = 1, n
        if (has_only_odd_digits(x(j))) then

            result(i) = x(j)

    do i = 1, len_result - 1
        do j = i + 1, len_result
            if (result(i) > result(j)) then
                temp = result(i)
                result(i) = result(j)
                result(j) = temp
            end if
        end do
    end do
    
    ! Output result
    do i = 1, len_result
        write(*, '(I0)') result(i)
    end do

                has_odd = .false.
                exit
            end if
            temp = temp / 10
        end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

end program collatz_odds

    character(len=100) :: string, substring
    integer :: count, i, len_str, len_sub

    implicit none
    integer :: n_input, i
    real, allocatable :: numbers(:), rescaled(:)
    real :: min_val, max_val

    read(*,*) n_input

    read(*,*) numbers
    
    ! Find min and max
    min_val = numbers(1)
    max_val = numbers(1)
    do i = 2, n_input
        if (numbers(i) < min_val) min_val = numbers(i)
        if (numbers(i) > max_val) max_val = numbers(i)
    end do
    
    ! Apply linear transform

    end if
    
    ! Output result
    do i = 1, n_input
        write(*, '(F8.3)') rescaled(i)
    end do
    
    deallocate(numbers)

program collatz_odds

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers

        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program rescale_to_unit
    implicit none
    integer :: n_input, i
    real, allocatable :: numbers(:), rescaled(:)
    real :: min_val, max_val
    
    ! Read input
    read(*,*) n_input
    allocate(numbers(n_input))
    read(*,*) numbers
    
    ! Find min and max
    min_val = numbers(1)
    max_val = numbers(1)
    do i = 2, n_input
        if (numbers(i) < min_val) min_val = numbers(i)
        if (numbers(i) > max_val) max_val = numbers(i)
    end do
    
    ! Apply linear transform
    if (max_val == min_val) then
        rescaled = 0.0
    else
        rescaled = (numbers - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
    end if
    
    ! Output result
    do i = 1, n_input
        write(*, '(F8.3)') rescaled(i)
    end do
    
    deallocate(numbers)

    real :: a, b, c, area, s

        ! Calculate area using Heron's formula

        ! Output area rounded to 2 decimal places

    else

        write (*, '(I6)') -1
    end if

    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)

            end if
        end do
    end do

        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

end program collatz_odds

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

end program collatz_odds

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)

        end do
    end do

        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)

program rescale_to_unit
    implicit none
    integer :: n_input, i
    real, allocatable :: numbers(:), rescaled(:)
    real :: min_val, max_val
    
    ! Read input
    read(*,*) n_input
    allocate(numbers(n_input))
    read(*,*) numbers
    
    ! Find min and max
    min_val = numbers(1)
    max_val = numbers(1)
    do i = 2, n_input
        if (numbers(i) < min_val) min_val = numbers(i)
        if (numbers(i) > max_val) max_val = numbers(i)
    end do
    
    ! Apply linear transform
    if (max_val == min_val) then
        rescaled = 0.0
    else
        rescaled = (numbers - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
    end if
    
    ! Output result
    do i = 1, n_input
        write(*, '(F8.3)') rescaled(i)
    end do
    
    deallocate(numbers)
end program rescale_to_unit

program triangle_area
    implicit none
    real :: a, b, c, area, s
    real :: result

    ! Read input
    read *, a
    read *, b
    read *, c

    ! Check if triangle is valid using triangle inequality theorem
    if (a + b > c .and. a + c > b .and. b + c > a) then
        ! Calculate semi-perimeter
        s = (a + b + c) / 2.0
        ! Calculate area using Heron's formula
        area = sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))
        ! Output area rounded to 2 decimal places
        write (*, '(F6.2)') area
    else
        ! Output -1 for invalid triangle
        write (*, '(I6)') -1
    end if

end program triangle_area

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers

        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if

    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if

    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)

    end do

    end do

    do i = 2, n_input

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else

        end if

        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort

        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)

program triangle_area
    implicit none
    real :: a, b, c, area, s
    real :: result

    ! Read input
    read *, a
    read *, b
    read *, c

    ! Check if triangle is valid using triangle inequality theorem
    if (a + b > c .and. a + c > b .and. b + c > a) then
        ! Calculate semi-perimeter
        s = (a + b + c) / 2.0
        ! Calculate area using Heron's formula
        area = sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))
        ! Output area rounded to 2 decimal places
        write (*, '(F6.2)') area
    else
        ! Output -1 for invalid triangle
        write (*, '(I6)') -1
    end if

end program triangle_area

    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

    end do

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

end program collatz_odds

    ! Find min and max
    min_val = numbers(1)

    do i = 2, n_input

    end if
    
    ! Output result

    end do
    
    deallocate(numbers)

program triangle_area
    implicit none
    real :: a, b, c, area, s
    real :: result

    ! Read input
    read *, a
    read *, b
    read *, c

    ! Check if triangle is valid using triangle inequality theorem
    if (a + b > c .and. a + c > b .and. b + c > a) then
        ! Calculate semi-perimeter
        s = (a + b + c) / 2.0
        ! Calculate area using Heron's formula
        area = sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))
        ! Output area rounded to 2 decimal places
        write (*, '(F6.2)') area
    else
        ! Output -1 for invalid triangle
        write (*, '(I6)') -1
    end if

end program triangle_area

    count = 0

    do while (temp > 0)

            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then

        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)

            end if

    end do

    end do

    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if

    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n

        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if

        do j = i + 1, count

                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)

program collatz_odds
    implicit none
    integer :: n
    integer, allocatable :: odd_collatz(:)
    integer :: i, j, temp, count

    ! Read input
    read *, n

    ! Collect odd numbers from Collatz sequence
    count = 0
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Allocate array for odd numbers
    allocate(odd_collatz(count))
    count = 0

    ! Collect odd numbers again
    temp = n
    do while (temp > 0)
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 1) then
            count = count + 1
            odd_collatz(count) = temp
        end if
        if (temp == 1) exit
        if (mod(temp, 2) == 0) then
            temp = temp / 2
        else
            temp = 3 * temp + 1
        end if
    end do

    ! Sort the odd numbers using bubble sort
    do i = 1, count - 1
        do j = i + 1, count
            if (odd_collatz(i) > odd_collatz(j)) then
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) + odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(j) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
                odd_collatz(i) = odd_collatz(i) - odd_collatz(j)
            end if
        end do
    end do

    ! Output the sorted odd numbers
    do i = 1, count
        write (*, '(I0)') odd_collatz(i)
    end do

program x_or_y
    implicit none
    integer :: n, x, y
    integer :: i
    logical :: is_prime
    
    ! Read input
    read *, n
    read *, x
    read *, y
    
    ! Check if n is prime
    is_prime = .true.
    if (n <= 1) then
        is_prime = .false.
    else
        do i = 2, int(sqrt(real(n)))
            if (mod(n, i) == 0) then
                is_prime = .false.
                exit
            end if
        end do
    end if
    
    ! Output result
    if (is_prime) then
        print *, x
    else
        print *, y
    end if

program hungry_rabbit
    implicit none
    integer :: already_eaten, needed, remaining
    integer :: total_eaten, carrots_left
    
    ! Read input values
    read *, already_eaten
    read *, needed
    read *, remaining
    
    ! Calculate total eaten and remaining carrots
    if (remaining >= needed) then
        total_eaten = already_eaten + needed
        carrots_left = remaining - needed
    else
        total_eaten = already_eaten + remaining
        carrots_left = 0
    end if
    
    ! Output the result
    write (*, *) total_eaten, carrots_left
